name: AirPlay
author: Jon
description: AirPlay for Omarchy, modelled on the Mac: mirror the screen, send one window, or use a TV as a second desktop, with sound

barWidget.description: The AirPlay menu: pick a TV, then this screen, one window or a second desktop, with video or video and system audio. Driven by a native Rust sender with zero-copy GPU capture and about 5 ms from capture to encoded frame.
